name: RAVENSBURG
detailed_description:
RAVENSBURG is a fast-hitting RPG inspired by camp and class B horror movies of the early 2000s. Step into a city turned upside down by a terrifying Gnostic cult as a vampire sent by the Church to defeat the diabolical menace. You're the last resort, the pill that is too hard to swallow, the cure bitter than the sickness. And you must save the City before the Demiurgic forces destroy it completely. Survive this blend of Gothic horror, Lovecraftian tale and anime aesthetics with the help of your 11 charismatic companions, each with their own personality and agenda, forge friendships or more with them as you work together to reclaim the city.

Embody Valdrich, a vampire with a gift for fighting and a rather questionable talent for thinking, and Kazia, his loyal companion with a lethal aim, but whose patience is shorter than the lives of their enemies.

The world of RAVENSBURG is extremely bleak and grim, intended for a MATURE AUDIENCE ONLY seeking a thought-provoking experience—one where cruelty, depravity, misery, and evil lurk around every corner, and only a select few are willing to face them, not always for the purest of reasons. The game does not shy away from dark themes or from exposing the worst aspects of the human condition, which are often met with cynicism and a bitter sense of humor.

This does not mean that RAVENSBURG is a world without HOPE. At every opportunity, the player is given both the means and the freedom to resolve the problems that arise along the way and is encouraged to never surrender—to embrace the journey, no matter the cost.

These are just some of the characters you'll meet in this dark journey!

  • Lovecraftian Horror x Anime: The best of anime-inspired visuals and characters with the best of Gothic and Lovecraftian horror mixed in a single game.

  • Form Your Perfect Team: Assemble your party from a cast of 11 playable characters. Each character brings unique skills and abilities you can customize.

  • Relationship System: Develop your relation with your companions, each with their own stories, ambitions, and secrets. Gain their loyalty or affection, either through deeds or interactions with them.

  • Thrilling Main Story: Uncover the dark truth behind the cult's power through a layered narrative filled with Lovecraftian mysteries and Charismatic Antagonists.

  • Stylish Gothic Art & Atmosphere: The femenine beauty of holy statues clashes with the atrocities committed by the Cult and decadent buildings towering the dark sky in this richly detailed world.

  • Open World and Eldritch Mystery: Investigate chilling encounters, solve companion quests, and confront the city's horrors using your own skills and strategies to shape your journey with open-ended freedom.

  • Unforgiving Combat: Engage in intense turn-based battles against unspeakable horrors. Use your resources strategically to survive deadly encounters, unlock new districts, and upgrade your party’s skills and equipment.

  • Mansion Exploration: Discover +25 unique rooms in Ravenstein, the Gothic mansion that serves as your main base. Each offering lore, new skills, resources and opportunities to interact with your companions.

  • Original Soundtrack: A haunting, melancholic but energic soundtrack composed by the talented composer Devil Mistakes.

Enjoy the thrill of uncovering hidden horrors while making friends and enemies in a doomed city plagued by secrets beyond comprehension!

short_description: RAVENSBURG is a haunting RPG where you play as a vampire. Here Lovecraftian Horror meets Anime. Liberate a cult-ridden city, uncover mysteries, and fight horrors beyond imagination while befriending attractive companions. Unravel a gothic mansion, and explore the city’s darkest depths.

content_descriptors.notes:
RAVENSBURG is set in a dark and gothic world, portraying themes of horror, violence, and depravity in a fictional context. The game contains explicit depictions of extreme violence, gore, and dismemberment. Blood drinking is a core gameplay mechanic. Additional mature content includes the use of alcohol and drugs, acts of cruelty, nudity, sexual acts—including BDSM—and instances of coercive blood drinking and forceful erotic interactions. The game also features crude humor.

Themes of human sacrifice, religious cults, lethal violence, and the atrocities associated with such practices are explored. Elements of sexual violence and mental health struggles are also present within the narrative.

These subjects are presented exclusively within a fictional framework, serving to enhance the dark, immersive setting and provide a mature, thought-provoking experience. The game offers players the tools and choices to confront these challenges and overcome adversity.

RAVENSBURG is intended for an adult audience only. Player discretion is strongly advised.
